commands.review_summary:
The PR adds Policy doctor fix metadata, automatic `doctor --fix` repairs for selected narrowing policy findings, docs/tests, and a plugin-SDK-visible `fixRecommendation` field.

PR surface: Source +889, Tests +450, Docs +32, Other +8. Total +1379 across 18 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection at the PR head shows the telemetry repair replaces object-valued `diagnostics.otel.captureContent` with `false`, and the new test expects that overwrite.

target.title: policy: repair automatic narrowing findings
target.body:
## Summary  - add automatic policy repair helpers for the first safe narrowing slice - wire repair handlers only for:   - `policy/tools-elevated-enabled`   - `policy/gateway-control-ui-insecure`   - `policy/gateway-remote-enabled`   - `policy/data-handling-redaction-disabled`   - `policy/data-handling-telemetry-content-capture` - keep review-required/manual findings detect-only - preserve policy repair safety by requiring `plugins.entries.policy.config.workspaceRepairs=true` - avoid over-applying scoped elevated findings globally and repair remote gateway posture through `gateway.remote.enabled=false`  ## Validation  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts --reporter=dot` (288 tests) - `pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm exec oxlint extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` - `git diff --check` - `codex review --base origin/policy-doctor-fix-rules` (clean after fixing accepted findings)  ## Not run  - `pnpm tsgo:core` remains blocked in this local worktree by pre-existing untracked `src/oc-path/` files with unused-symbol errors.  ## Stack  Stacked on #99686 (`policy: classify doctor fix recommendations`), which is stacked on #99121 (`policy: cover gateway node commands`). Rebase onto `main` after the lower stack lands.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
`doctor --fix` safely applies the first automatic policy narrowing repairs only when `workspaceRepairs=true`, covering elevated tools, insecure gateway control UI, remote gateway mode, disabled redaction, and telemetry content capture.

Real environment tested:
Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-fork` on the restacked policy series, top head `283c1bb4ca` and this PR head `fd507931b3`. This is a source-harness proof; it does not start a packaged OpenClaw binary or make live LLM calls.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts --reporter=dot`
2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot`
3. `pnpm tsgo:extensions`
4. `pnpm lint:extensions`
5. `git diff --check`

Evidence after fix:
The focused policy/core Vitest run passed 10 core repair-flow tests and 297 policy doctor tests, including `repairs automatic policy narrowing config findings` and no-repair behavior without the workspace repair opt-in. The SDK surface tooling test passed 7 tests. `tsgo:extensions`, `lint:extensions`, and `git diff --check` all exited 0.

Observed result after fix:
Automatic policy narrowing repairs mutate only the exact config paths reported by policy findings and keep review-required/manual findings detect-only.

What was not tested:
No packaged CLI smoke, live provider run, or live LLM call was run for this source-harness proof.
